content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

The fastest way to set up a crypto payment system is by deploying a minimum viable stack that integrates blockchain-based payments. This stack can be deployed in a matter of hours, not days or weeks. By utilizing decentralized infrastructure like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, creators can start selling digital products without relying on restricted platforms. This approach ensures that creators own their infrastructure, eliminating the risk of platform dependency and associated fees.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

A functional minimum viable stack consists of a hosting solution, a backend logic provider, and a payment processor. For hosting, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages offer free, scalable solutions. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script provide the necessary functionality. Lastly, NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This stack is deployable in 48 hours, allowing creators to quickly start selling digital products and receiving crypto payments.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

To expedite the deployment process, creators should focus on the essential components of their commerce stack. Non-essential features, such as advanced analytics or customized storefronts, can be added later. By prioritizing the core functionality of their stack, creators can quickly start selling and generating revenue. This approach also allows for iteration and improvement based on real-world feedback and sales data.
Deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure stack in 48 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

The first transaction is a critical milestone for any creator. By leveraging the minimum viable stack and decentralized infrastructure, creators can ensure that their first transaction is processed quickly and securely. With NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing their customers with a wide range of payment options. This flexibility, combined with the low fees associated with blockchain-based payments, makes it an attractive option for creators and customers alike.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, creators should focus on deploying their minimum viable stack and setting up their crypto payment system. This involves selecting a hosting solution, configuring backend logic, and integrating NOWPayments. By following a structured deployment plan, creators can ensure that their stack is functional and secure. Additionally, they should prepare their digital products for sale, including pricing, product descriptions, and download links. With a functional stack and prepared products, creators can start selling and generating revenue in no time.
